graphNodes.summary: Jasnah’s use of Transportation to enter or exit Shadesmar, often paired with precise Soulcasting and Cognitive navigation.

graphNodes.name: Regrowth
graphNodes.summary: Progression-based healing applied to another person, used by Lift, Renarin, and hidden Truthwatchers.

graphNodes.name: Connection manipulation
graphNodes.summary: Spiritual relationships among people, places, languages, and powers. Dalinar can temporarily forge linguistic understanding and unify realms in ways tied to Connection.

graphNodes.name: Stormlight self-healing
graphNodes.summary: Stormlight repairs a Radiant according to Spiritual identity, including old wounds when the person no longer accepts them as defining.

graphNodes.name: Living Shardblade
graphNodes.summary: A sufficiently advanced Radiant spren can become a weapon or tool instantly and in changing shapes, unlike dead Shardblades’ delayed summoning.

graphNodes.name: Dead Shardblade
graphNodes.summary: Corpse-like Physical manifestation of a spren whose Radiant broke oaths during the Recreance. Gemstones added later enable bonding and ten-heartbeat summoning.

graphNodes.name: Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: Ancient powered armor that enhances strength and resists damage, recharged by Stormlight gemstones. Its full relationship to Radiant bonds is not yet explained by Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Oathgate travel
graphNodes.summary: Paired spren and platforms teleport groups between Urithiru and ten cities. A living Shardblade normally unlocks the mechanism.

graphNodes.name: Fabrials
graphNodes.summary: Devices using trapped spren and gemstone configurations to create repeatable effects such as communication, heating, pain reduction, detection, or paired motion.

graphNodes.name: Spanreeds
graphNodes.summary: Paired writing reeds whose movement is conjoined at distance, enabling written communication when aligned and supplied with Stormlight.

graphNodes.name: Painrial
graphNodes.summary: Fabrial that reduces or transfers the perception of pain without repairing underlying injury.

graphNodes.name: Conjoiner fabrials
graphNodes.summary: Paired gemstones that reproduce motion in linked ways, foundation of spanreeds and Navani’s transport experiments.

graphNodes.name: Soulcaster fabrials
graphNodes.summary: Ancient devices shaped like hand ornaments that grant narrow Transformation capabilities to non-Radiants. Modern artifabrians cannot reproduce them.

graphNodes.name: Half-shards
graphNodes.summary: Shields reinforced by fabrials enough to block several Shardblade strikes, developed in Jah Keved and used by elite troops.

graphNodes.name: Perfect gemstones
graphNodes.summary: Exceptionally cut gemstones that leak little or no Stormlight and can imprison powerful spren. The King’s Drop is the key example.

graphNodes.name: Singer forms
graphNodes.summary: Singers take different forms by bonding spren in their gemhearts during highstorms, changing body, temperament, skills, and accessible rhythms.

graphNodes.name: Rhythms of Roshar
graphNodes.summary: Perceived rhythms used by singers to express emotion, coordinate, and interpret experience. Forms of power introduce new Odium-aligned rhythms.

graphNodes.name: Forms of power / Regals
graphNodes.summary: Singer forms gained by bonding voidspren, granting abilities such as stormform lightning and linking the user to Odium’s rhythms and influence.

graphNodes.name: Fused Surgebinding
graphNodes.summary: Fused use one specialized Surge-like ability per type, powered by Voidlight and refined across repeated lives.

graphNodes.name: Old Magic
graphNodes.summary: Boon-and-curse encounters associated with the Nightwatcher. Cultivation sometimes intervenes directly for more deliberate long-term changes.

graphNodes.name: Cultivation’s memory pruning
graphNodes.summary: Cultivation removes Dalinar’s memory of Evi and then arranges for it to return gradually, giving him time to become someone able to face it.

graphNodes.name: Awakening
graphNodes.summary: Using Breath, color, visualization, and Commands to animate objects. Azure demonstrates it in Kholinar and Shadesmar; Zahel’s identity links the system to Warbreaker.

graphNodes.name: BioChromatic Breath
graphNodes.summary: Transferable unit of innate Investiture on Nalthis. Large quantities grant Heightenings; Returned require a continuing supply. Zahel adapts to Roshar’s Stormlight ecosystem.

graphNodes.name: Nightblood’s consumption
graphNodes.summary: When drawn, Nightblood consumes the wielder’s available Investiture, then life, while destroying matter and spiritual structure with extreme force.

graphNodes.name: Allomancy
graphNodes.summary: Metal-burning magic from Mistborn. Included as background for Scadrian worldhoppers; no overt Allomantic set piece is required to understand Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Feruchemy
graphNodes.summary: Stores personal attributes in metalminds for later retrieval. Useful background for Cosmere Identity and Connection discussions.

graphNodes.name: Hemalurgy
graphNodes.summary: Transfers spiritual attributes using metal spikes at severe moral and spiritual cost. Included only as pre-2017 Cosmere context.

graphNodes.name: Invested white sand
graphNodes.summary: Sand from Taldain changes appearance when it absorbs nearby Investiture, making it useful as a detector. A jar in Oathbringer helps reveal anomalous activity.

graphNodes.name: Fortune
graphNodes.summary: Spiritual mechanism associated with glimpsing or positioning oneself toward possible futures. Riino’s device and Odium/Renarin future sight imply distinct applications.

graphNodes.name: Death Rattles
graphNodes.summary: Cryptic statements spoken near death under Moelach’s influence, gathered systematically by Taravangian’s secret hospitals.

graphNodes.name: The Thrill
graphNodes.summary: Nergaoul’s enhancement of aggression, pleasure in combat, and loss of inhibition. Alethi culture mistakes it for normal warrior experience until Dalinar identifies the source.

graphNodes.name: Midnight Essence
graphNodes.summary: Black imitative creatures formed by Re-Shephir to copy violence and anatomy she observes.

graphNodes.name: Oathpact
graphNodes.summary: Ancient agreement binding Heralds and Fused to a cycle involving Braize. Nine Heralds abandon it at Aharietiam, leaving Taln alone to maintain the barrier.

graphNodes.name: Desolation cycle
graphNodes.summary: Repeated wars triggered when Heralds returned from Braize and Fused followed. The Everstorm creates a new route that no longer depends on the old timing.

graphNodes.name: Gemstones and polestones
graphNodes.summary: Cut gemstones store Stormlight; gem type, cut, and trapped spren determine many fabrial and Soulcasting properties.

graphNodes.name: Ten Essences
graphNodes.summary: Vorin-linked material categories used in Soulcasting theory, each associated with properties, gemstones, and Heraldic symbolism.

graphNodes.name: Dawnshard / Command
graphNodes.summary: One of the ancient Commands associated with the deepest pre-Shattering history of the Cosmere. In Akinah, a Dawnshard leaves its mural and bonds Rysn, changing her perception and making her strategically important far beyond Roshar.

graphNodes.name: Lifelight
graphNodes.summary: Cultivation-associated Light. Lift metabolizes food into Lifelight rather than drawing ordinary Stormlight, and the Sibling combines Cultivation’s tone with Honor’s to create Towerlight.

graphNodes.name: Towerlight
graphNodes.summary: The Sibling’s native hybrid Investiture, created from the tones/powers of Honor and Cultivation. Navani and the Sibling restore it when they form their Bondsmith bond.

graphNodes.name: Warlight
graphNodes.summary: Stable mixture of Stormlight and Voidlight created when Navani and Raboniel bring Honor’s and Odium’s tones/rhythms into harmony. Its creation disproves Raboniel’s assumption that the Lights must annihilate one another.

graphNodes.name: Pure Tones of Roshar
graphNodes.summary: Fundamental tones associated with Roshar’s Shards and their Lights. Navani’s research shows Light responds to tone and rhythm, allowing transfer, mixing, inversion, and eventually anti-Light production.

graphNodes.name: Anti-Light
graphNodes.summary: Investiture placed into a phase/opposition corresponding to a Light’s tone. When Light and its anti-Light meet through the correct medium, the reaction can annihilate Investiture and permanently kill normally returning Fused or bonded spren.

graphNodes.name: Anti-Voidlight
graphNodes.summary: Anti-phase counterpart to Odium’s Voidlight, first deliberately produced by Navani. It can force reactions with Voidlight and permanently destroy a Fused soul when delivered effectively.

graphNodes.name: Anti-Stormlight
graphNodes.summary: Anti-phase counterpart to Stormlight. Raboniel applies Navani’s method to produce it; it enables the permanent killing of spren and is demonstrated against Phendorana and later Lezian’s Investiture.

graphNodes.name: Raysium conduction
graphNodes.summary: Odium-associated metal used in specialized daggers to conduct Investiture between a target and gemstone, making it central to Jezrien-style capture weapons and anti-Light delivery.

graphNodes.name: Radiant suppression fabrials
graphNodes.summary: Devices using corrupted spren and principles related to Urithiru’s defenses to suppress Radiant powers. Study of a captured device helps Navani understand the tower’s vulnerability.

graphNodes.name: Sibling-integrated fabrials
graphNodes.summary: Urithiru itself functions as a vast living fabrial complex through the Sibling: pressure, heat, water, lighting, defenses, communications, and power suppression are integrated into the tower.

graphNodes.name: Fabrial metal interactions
graphNodes.summary: Rhythm of War makes explicit that metals placed around trapped spren alter fabrial behavior in systematic ways; aluminum can block or isolate effects, and other metals push/pull or otherwise modify responses.

graphNodes.name: Living Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: At the Fourth Ideal, Kaladin gains Shardplate formed from windspren. The living Plate can move between people under his intent, contrasting with dead traditional Plate.

graphNodes.name: Enlightened spren
graphNodes.summary: Spren altered by Sja-anat retain agency while changing nature and capabilities. Renarin’s Glys and Rlain’s Tumi demonstrate Radiant bonds with enlightened spren that can disturb Odium’s future sight.

graphNodes.name: Oathbringer
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar’s famous dead Shardblade, won during his youth and named for his reputation. He trades it to Sadeas for Bridge Four; it later passes to Amaram. Dalinar ultimately refuses to wield it as he confronts what the name once meant.

graphNodes.name: Mayalaran / Adolin’s Blade
graphNodes.summary: Adolin’s dead Shardblade, later identified in Shadesmar as the cultivationspren Mayalaran. His habit of speaking to and respecting the Blade precedes unusual responsiveness.

graphNodes.name: Sunraiser
graphNodes.summary: Elhokar’s ornate Shardblade, carried as the king’s weapon through the Shattered Plains and Kholinar mission.

graphNodes.name: Helaran’s Shardblade
graphNodes.summary: Blade carried by Helaran during his attack on Amaram’s army. After Kaladin kills him, Amaram murders Kaladin’s surviving squad, steals the Blade, and pretends to have won it.

graphNodes.name: Sylblade
graphNodes.summary: Syl’s ability to become weapons and tools once Kaladin reaches the required bond level. She shifts shape rapidly rather than remaining a fixed sword.

graphNodes.name: Patternblade
graphNodes.summary: Pattern’s weapon form. Shallan’s relationship to multiple childhood memories makes the exact history emotionally complicated, but by WoR Pattern can act as her living Blade.

graphNodes.name: Ivory’s Blade form
graphNodes.summary: Ivory’s living weapon manifestation for Jasnah, with the adaptable properties of a healthy Nahel bond.

graphNodes.name: Wyndle’s Blade form
graphNodes.summary: Wyndle reluctantly manifests as a weapon/tool for Lift, often shaped into a fork-like form to suit her reluctance to kill.

graphNodes.name: Jezrien’s Honorblade
graphNodes.summary: Ancient Blade granting Adhesion and Gravitation without a spren bond. Szeth wields it as Truthless until Kaladin defeats him at Narak; it then comes into Kholin possession.

graphNodes.name: Blade carried by Taln
graphNodes.summary: Taln arrives in Kholinar carrying a Blade that is later swapped before Dalinar receives it. The identity and chain of custody remain deliberately unresolved within Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Nightblood
graphNodes.summary: Sentient Nalthian sword created to destroy evil, with catastrophic Investiture consumption. It passes from Nale to Szeth and is used at Thaylen Field.

graphNodes.name: Azure’s sword
graphNodes.summary: A distinctive silvery weapon used by Azure. It is not a conventional Rosharan Shardblade; its behavior and origin connect to Nalthian experimentation, though details remain unrevealed by Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Gavilar’s black sphere
graphNodes.summary: Dark, violet-black gemstone Gavilar gives Szeth while dying, asking that it be kept from 'them.' It contains unfamiliar light associated with Odium’s forces; deeper technical explanation belongs beyond this spoiler boundary.

graphNodes.name: The King’s Drop
graphNodes.summary: Huge, exceptionally cut ruby in Thaylenah’s reserve. It stores Investiture without leakage; Rysn protects it and Dalinar uses it to imprison Nergaoul.

graphNodes.name: Jezrien-killing dagger
graphNodes.summary: Special knife with a gemstone pommel supplied by Odium’s forces. Moash uses it to kill Jezrien and capture or disrupt the Herald’s essence.

graphNodes.name: Szeth’s Oathstone
graphNodes.summary: Ordinary stone invested with cultural authority rather than magical compulsion. Szeth believes Truthless law requires absolute obedience to its holder.

graphNodes.name: Adolin’s Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: Kholin Shardplate used in hunts, duels, and war. Damaged segments can be regrown with Stormlight.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar’s Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: Blackthorn-era and modern battle armor associated with Dalinar. He increasingly rejects personal Shardbearing as his Bondsmith role develops.

graphNodes.name: Helaran’s Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: Plate worn by Helaran during the battlefield attack where Kaladin kills him; stolen along with the Blade by Amaram.

graphNodes.name: Shardbows
graphNodes.summary: Oversized bows normally requiring Shardplate strength. Rock uses one without Plate at Thaylen Field to kill Amaram, assisted by his unusual Horneater strength and position.

graphNodes.name: The Way of Kings
graphNodes.summary: Nohadon’s moral-political text. Gavilar’s final message directs Dalinar to it; Dalinar tries to shape his rule around its principles despite uncertainty about their historical application.

graphNodes.name: Words of Radiance
graphNodes.summary: In-world history of the Knights Radiant, used by Jasnah and Shallan and quoted in epigraphs to recover order structure and Urithiru clues.

graphNodes.name: Oathbringer: My Glory and My Shame
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar’s autobiographical work, dictated and written publicly without a feminine undertext, confronting the Blackthorn’s crimes and arguing that responsibility begins by owning pain rather than surrendering it.

graphNodes.name: The Diagram
graphNodes.summary: Enormous collection of instructions, deductions, and diagrams dictated by Taravangian on his most intelligent day, then interpreted by a secret organization.

graphNodes.name: Mythica
graphNodes.summary: Jasnah-associated text cataloging the Unmade, used by the coalition to identify phenomena such as the Midnight Mother and the Thrill.

graphNodes.name: Dawnchant translations
graphNodes.summary: Ancient language decoded through Urithiru scholarship. Its records reveal humans came from Ashyn and were the original invaders relative to the singers.

graphNodes.name: Urithiru gemstone archive
graphNodes.summary: Gemstones carrying ancient Radiant messages, each recorded in a gemstone associated with the speaker’s order. They document internal doubts before the Recreance and the danger of Ba-Ado-Mishram.

graphNodes.name: Listener songs
graphNodes.summary: Rhythm-preserved songs carrying listener history, forms, warnings, and fragmented knowledge of old gods and humans.

graphNodes.name: Shallan’s sketchbooks
graphNodes.summary: Drawings used for scholarship, memory, emotional insight, disguise design, and Lightweaving. They often capture truths Shallan consciously avoids.

graphNodes.name: Wit’s flute
graphNodes.summary: Flute Wit gives Kaladin after a story. Kaladin loses or abandons it during his transition from the warcamps, making it a symbol of neglected parts of himself.

graphNodes.name: Jasnah’s Soulcaster decoy
graphNodes.summary: Fabrial-like ornament Jasnah wears to conceal that she Soulcasts through a Nahel bond. Shallan steals and damages it before learning it was a decoy.

graphNodes.name: Davar Soulcaster
graphNodes.summary: Broken Soulcaster tied to House Davar’s Ghostblood debt. Shallan hopes Jasnah’s apparent device can replace it and restore the family’s finances.

graphNodes.name: Coalition spanreed network
graphNodes.summary: Paired writing devices used for politics, intelligence, and logistics across Roshar before and alongside Oathgate travel.

graphNodes.name: Navani’s painrial
graphNodes.summary: Portable pain-reduction device used in medical and battlefield situations. It suppresses sensation rather than healing damage.

graphNodes.name: Jar of white sand
graphNodes.summary: Offworld sand that changes when exposed to Investiture, used as an alarm or diagnostic clue in Urithiru.

graphNodes.name: Aluminum-lined materials
graphNodes.summary: Rare offworld-linked metal that blocks or interferes with several magical effects. Oathbringer uses it in covert and protective contexts without fully systematizing the science.

graphNodes.name: Oathgate platforms
graphNodes.summary: Ten city platforms and the central Urithiru controls, each governed by paired spren and activated through Shardblade interfaces.

graphNodes.name: The Honorblades
graphNodes.summary: Ten Blades given to the Heralds by Honor, granting Surges without spren bonds at greater Stormlight cost. Most are held in Shinovar after Aharietiam.

graphNodes.name: Half-shard shields
graphNodes.summary: Fabrial-reinforced shields that can survive limited Shardblade impacts, fielded by elite Veden/Alethi troops.

graphNodes.name: Soulcast blood antidote
graphNodes.summary: Jasnah transforms Shallan’s blood to remove poison after the failed Kabsal attack, demonstrating precise biological Soulcasting.

graphNodes.name: Bridge crews and mobile bridges
graphNodes.summary: Heavy bridges carried by expendable enslaved crews to span chasms under fire, central to Sadeas’s tactics and Bridge Four’s trauma.

graphNodes.name: Gemstone Shardbearer bond set
graphNodes.summary: Gemstone and ritual apparatus used to bond dead Shardblades for summoning; a later human adaptation rather than part of original living Radiant bonds.

graphNodes.name: Akinah Dawnshard mural
graphNodes.summary: Ancient mural/container in Akinah that houses a Dawnshard Command until it leaves the artwork and bonds Rysn.

graphNodes.name: Wandersail (Rysn’s ship)
graphNodes.summary: Rysn’s Thaylen vessel, adapted for her mobility and used for the expedition to Akinah.

graphNodes.name: Rhythm of War notebook
graphNodes.summary: Joint scientific notebook of Navani and Raboniel documenting Light, tones, Warlight, and anti-Light. Copies allow both sides to retain the discoveries.

graphNodes.name: Anti-Voidlight dagger
graphNodes.summary: Raysium-assisted dagger configuration carrying anti-Voidlight, capable of permanently killing Fused rather than merely sending them back to Braize.

graphNodes.name: Anti-Stormlight dagger
graphNodes.summary: Weaponized anti-Stormlight delivery system. Moash uses it to permanently kill Phendorana; El later applies the research against Lezian.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin’s fabrial flight glove
graphNodes.summary: Navani-designed conjoiner-based glove that gives Kaladin limited directional lift while Urithiru suppresses his Gravitation, allowing him to move through and outside the tower.

graphNodes.name: Captured Radiant suppressor
graphNodes.summary: Portable Fused suppression device captured early in Rhythm of War. Navani studies its corrupted-spren construction and notices parallels to Urithiru’s gemstone pillar.

graphNodes.name: Cord’s Akinah Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: Ancient Shardplate recovered from Akinah and claimed by Cord during the expedition.

graphNodes.name: Akinah Soulcaster cache
graphNodes.summary: Multiple ancient Soulcasters discovered in Akinah’s hidden stores and divided among allied powers under the expedition’s negotiated cover story.

graphNodes.name: Rysn’s fabrial mobility device
graphNodes.summary: A fabrial-assisted mobility solution developed during the voyage after Huio’s observations about aluminum and fabrial behavior, designed to make movement aboard ship easier for Rysn.

graphNodes.name: Shattering of Adonalsium
graphNodes.summary: Adonalsium is shattered into sixteen Shards; Honor, Cultivation, and Odium become three of the resulting powers relevant to Roshar.

graphNodes.name: Honor and Cultivation shape Rosharan civilization
graphNodes.summary: Honor and Cultivation become Roshar’s resident Shards and interact with singers, spren, and the existing ecology.

graphNodes.name: Human catastrophe on Ashyn
graphNodes.summary: Human use of powerful Surges destroys or devastates Ashyn, remembered later as the Tranquiline Halls.

graphNodes.name: Humans migrate from Ashyn to Roshar
graphNodes.summary: Refugees arrive on Roshar and are initially given Shinovar; expansion and conflict follow.

graphNodes.name: First Desolation and human–singer war
graphNodes.summary: Odium’s alignment with human arrivals and later singer conflict evolves into the first Desolation; exact early sequence remains fragmentary.

graphNodes.name: Oathpact formed
graphNodes.summary: Ten Heralds accept a cycle of return, war, death, torture on Braize, and renewed Desolation, supported by Honorblades.

graphNodes.name: Knights Radiant organized
graphNodes.summary: Humans bonding spren are organized into ten orders around Ideals, Surges, and Heraldic models.

graphNodes.name: Aharietiam: nine Heralds abandon the Oathpact
graphNodes.summary: After a Desolation, nine Heralds leave their Honorblades and tell humanity the war is over, leaving Taln alone on Braize.

graphNodes.name: False Desolation led by Ba-Ado-Mishram
graphNodes.summary: Ba-Ado-Mishram connects to singers broadly, supplies forms and Voidlight, and leads war despite Odium’s confinement.

graphNodes.name: Ba-Ado-Mishram imprisoned
graphNodes.summary: A strike team imprisons Ba-Ado-Mishram. The event damages singer populations connected to her, producing the slaveform/parshman state remembered by humans.

graphNodes.name: The Recreance
graphNodes.summary: Most Knights Radiant deliberately abandon their oaths and Shards, creating deadeye spren and ending the orders as public institutions.

graphNodes.name: Vorin Hierocracy rises and falls
graphNodes.summary: Vorin church attempts direct rule and manipulates records; the Sunmaker defeats it, leaving lasting distrust of priestly political power.

graphNodes.name: Gavilar and Dalinar unify Alethkar
graphNodes.summary: Gavilar’s political ambition and Dalinar’s Blackthorn campaigns force the princedoms into a kingdom.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar wins the Blade Oathbringer
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar defeats a Shardbearer and claims the Blade later named Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar marries Evi
graphNodes.summary: Political marriage links the Kholins with Riran interests. Evi tries to humanize Dalinar but remains isolated in Alethi culture.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar destroys Rathalas; Evi dies
graphNodes.summary: After rebellion and an ambush, Dalinar orders the Rift sealed and burned. Evi enters the city to negotiate and dies with its inhabitants.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar seeks the Nightwatcher and meets Cultivation
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar asks for release from his pain. Cultivation removes Evi’s memory and prepares it to regrow later rather than granting simple oblivion.

graphNodes.name: Gavilar’s expedition meets the listeners
graphNodes.summary: Alethi explorers encounter the listeners on the Shattered Plains; diplomacy turns toward manipulation and war planning.

graphNodes.name: Gavilar assassinated during treaty feast
graphNodes.summary: The listeners hire Szeth to kill Gavilar after learning enough of his plans to fear the return of their gods.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin’s squad fails to save Cenn
graphNodes.summary: Young recruit Cenn joins Kaladin’s unusually protective squad, but the battle is lost and Kaladin is later enslaved.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin transported as a slave
graphNodes.summary: After Amaram’s betrayal, Kaladin repeatedly escapes and is recaptured; Tvlakv purchases him for sale to the warcamps.

graphNodes.name: Shallan arrives in Kharbranth
graphNodes.summary: Shallan seeks Jasnah, intending to become her ward while stealing a Soulcaster to rescue House Davar.

graphNodes.name: Royal chasmfiend hunt nearly becomes a disaster
graphNodes.summary: A chasmfiend hunt exposes Elhokar’s fear, Dalinar and Adolin’s combat coordination, and apparently cut saddle straps.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin begins rebuilding Bridge Four
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin shifts from suicidal isolation to medical care, food redistribution, spear training, and collective escape planning.

graphNodes.name: Jasnah accepts Shallan as ward
graphNodes.summary: After testing Shallan’s scholarship and persistence, Jasnah accepts her, giving Shallan access to the Palanaeum and the object she plans to steal.

graphNodes.name: Three worldhoppers hire Ishikk
graphNodes.summary: Demoux, Galladon, and Baon search the Purelake for Hoid using assumed names.

graphNodes.name: Rysn trades in Shinovar
graphNodes.summary: Vstim teaches Rysn that successful trade requires understanding what another culture values, not merely imposing Thaylen assumptions.

graphNodes.name: Axies records Cusicesh
graphNodes.summary: Axies studies a massive scheduled spren while dealing with Iri’s authorities.

graphNodes.name: Baxil witnesses Shalash destroying her own image
graphNodes.summary: A patron later identifiable as Herald Shalash pays thieves while compulsively destroying depictions of herself.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin survives being strung up in a highstorm
graphNodes.summary: Bridge officers leave Kaladin exposed as punishment. He survives by drawing Stormlight while Syl defies the Stormfather’s pull.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin Ch. 40 aligns with Dalinar Ch. 12
graphNodes.summary: The novel’s viewpoint lines are not presented in one shared starting order; Kaladin’s Chapter 40 occurs on the day of Dalinar’s Chapter 12 chasmfiend hunt.

graphNodes.name: Kabsal’s poisoning attempt exposes Soulcasting
graphNodes.summary: Kabsal’s attempt to poison Jasnah instead poisons Shallan. Jasnah Soulcasts Shallan’s blood and reveals the stolen ornament was not the source of her power.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar witnesses the Recreance at Feverstone Keep
graphNodes.summary: In a vision, Radiants abandon Plate and Blade before stunned soldiers.

graphNodes.name: Shallan confesses theft and family crisis
graphNodes.summary: Shallan admits stealing the Soulcaster and explains House Davar’s danger. Jasnah recognizes Shallan as a fellow Surgebinder and keeps her as ward.

graphNodes.name: Sadeas abandons Dalinar at the Tower
graphNodes.summary: Sadeas withdraws his bridges, trapping the Kholin army against listener forces.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin speaks the Second Windrunner Ideal
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin commits to protect people who cannot protect themselves, draws Stormlight, and leads Bridge Four back across the chasm.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar trades Oathbringer for the bridgemen
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar gives Sadeas his Shardblade in exchange for ownership of every bridgeman, immediately freeing them and hiring Bridge Four.

graphNodes.name: Taravangian is revealed as Szeth’s master
graphNodes.summary: The kindly king’s hidden hospitals and control of Szeth reveal a second large conspiracy behind the assassination campaign.

graphNodes.name: Taln arrives at Kholinar
graphNodes.summary: A broken man carrying a Shardblade appears at the city gate and announces the Desolation.

graphNodes.name: Jasnah’s perspective on Gavilar’s assassination
graphNodes.summary: Jasnah survives an attempted arranged engagement, enters Shadesmar, meets Ivory, and receives Gavilar’s warning amid the assassination.

graphNodes.name: The Wind’s Pleasure is attacked
graphNodes.summary: Assassins attack Jasnah’s ship. Shallan Soulcasts to survive and believes Jasnah killed, while Jasnah escapes through Shadesmar.

graphNodes.name: Shallan takes control of Tvlakv’s caravan
graphNodes.summary: Stranded in the Frostlands, Shallan uses Lightweaving, social improvisation, and selective confidence to recruit guards and deserters.

graphNodes.name: Bridge Four tests Kaladin’s powers
graphNodes.summary: Sigzil and the crew measure Lashings, Stormlight use, and the relationship between Kaladin’s proximity and squire abilities.

graphNodes.name: Shallan kills Tyn and meets the Ghostblood trail
graphNodes.summary: Tyn reveals herself as part of the plot against Jasnah and attacks Shallan. Shallan summons a Blade and kills her, then assumes Tyn’s place in Ghostblood communications.

graphNodes.name: Shallan reaches the Shattered Plains
graphNodes.summary: Shallan enters Kholin politics, meets Adolin formally, begins mapping the Plains, and creates Veil for Ghostblood work.

graphNodes.name: Lift saves Gawx and makes an unlikely Prime
graphNodes.summary: Nale kills Gawx while hunting Lift; Lift returns and heals him. Azish law and politics then elevate the revived youth to Prime.

graphNodes.name: Eshonai takes stormform
graphNodes.summary: Eshonai tests stormform intending controlled evaluation, but the form and its rhythms overwhelm her and drive a coup within listener leadership.

graphNodes.name: Rysn is injured in the Reshi Isles
graphNodes.summary: Rysn climbs from a greatshell island, falls, and loses use of her legs. The Reshi give her Chiri-Chiri.

graphNodes.name: Adolin’s disadvantaged duel becomes four against one
graphNodes.summary: A political trap turns Adolin’s duel into a lethal group contest. Renarin enters despite little chance, and Kaladin joins with the declaration that honor is already dead.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin is imprisoned after challenging Amaram
graphNodes.summary: Elhokar reacts to Kaladin’s accusation as a challenge to lighteyed authority. Kaladin’s bitterness deepens and Moash’s assassination argument becomes more persuasive.

graphNodes.name: Shallan and Kaladin survive the chasms
graphNodes.summary: A highstorm traps them below the Plains. They share selective truths, fight a chasmfiend, and reach relative understanding.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin’s conflicting promises nearly kill Syl
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin has promised both to protect Elhokar and to allow Moash’s assassination. The contradiction violates his bond’s moral center, draining his powers and leaving Syl nearly mindless.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin speaks the Third Windrunner Ideal
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin chooses to protect Elhokar even though he hates him, restores Syl, and opposes Moash and Graves.

graphNodes.name: Battle of Narak and summoning of the Everstorm
graphNodes.summary: Alethi forces attack Narak as stormform listeners summon the Everstorm. Szeth attacks Dalinar; Kaladin defeats him; Shallan activates the Oathgate.

graphNodes.name: Nale restores Szeth and gives him Nightblood
graphNodes.summary: After Szeth’s defeat, Nale uses a fabrial to restore him, explains the Desolation’s return, and offers a new sword.

graphNodes.name: Adolin kills Sadeas
graphNodes.summary: Sadeas promises continued sabotage. In an unplanned confrontation, Adolin kills him and hides the body and weapon.

graphNodes.name: Jasnah returns from Shadesmar and meets Wit
graphNodes.summary: Jasnah finally exits the Cognitive Realm near the Plains and finds Wit waiting.

graphNodes.name: Lift leaves Azimir
graphNodes.summary: Uncomfortable with palace life and the idea of changing, Lift follows reports of a strange man killing people with powers and heads toward Yeddaw.

graphNodes.name: Lift investigates Yeddaw and the Stump
graphNodes.summary: Lift steals food, follows missing supplies, and discovers an orphanage whose sick children recover in ways the Stump does not understand.

graphNodes.name: Lift encounters Arclo, a Sleepless
graphNodes.summary: A man disassembles into cremlings and explains that the Sleepless are observing dangerous developments.

graphNodes.name: Lift protects the Stump and speaks her Third Ideal
graphNodes.summary: Lift chooses to listen to and remember someone Nale dismisses, heals the Stump, and forces Nale to confront the Everstorm’s proof.

graphNodes.name: Eshonai’s perspective on Gavilar’s final feast
graphNodes.summary: Eshonai meets Gavilar, learns he intends to restore the listeners’ old gods, and helps trigger the decision to assassinate him.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin returns to Hearthstone
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin finds his family alive under singer occupation, meets his baby brother, and tries to protect both humans and newly awakened singers.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar begins building the monarch coalition
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar uses visions, spanreeds, and Oathgate access to contact rulers who distrust Alethi conquest and his Blackthorn reputation.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin travels with awakened singers
graphNodes.summary: Separated from easy lines of allegiance, Kaladin joins Sah’s group and learns how parshmen experienced human ownership and family separation.

graphNodes.name: Copycat murders reveal Re-Shephir in Urithiru
graphNodes.summary: Violent deaths and impossible imitations lead Shallan into the tower’s depths, where the Midnight Mother has been learning from human cruelty.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar and Navani marry
graphNodes.summary: The Stormfather officiates a direct marriage despite Vorin political and religious objections.

graphNodes.name: Coalition rulers meet through Honor’s vision
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar brings multiple monarchs into a shared vision to prove the Desolation and negotiate cooperation.

graphNodes.name: Dawnchant translation reveals human origins
graphNodes.summary: Urithiru scholars translate records showing humans arrived from Ashyn and conquered land belonging to singers.

graphNodes.name: Strike team infiltrates Kholinar
graphNodes.summary: Elhokar, Kaladin, Shallan, Adolin, Azure’s contacts, and squires enter the occupied capital using disguises and covert routes.

graphNodes.name: The team meets Highmarshal Azure
graphNodes.summary: Azure commands the Wall Guard with an unusual sword and offworld idiom. She is searching for Zahel and Nightblood while defending the city.

graphNodes.name: Shallan enters the Heart of the Revel
graphNodes.summary: Undercover personas investigate Ashertmarn’s feast cult around the Oathgate. Shallan tries to become whatever each suffering person needs, multiplying identities faster than she can integrate them.

graphNodes.name: Wit tells Shallan the Girl Who Looked Up
graphNodes.summary: Wit uses story and Lightweaving to help Shallan distinguish acknowledging pain from becoming only the masks built around it.

graphNodes.name: Kholinar palace battle and Oathgate failure
graphNodes.summary: Singers, Fused, palace troops, the Wall Guard, and the infiltrators collide. Sja-anat-corrupted Oathgate spren redirect the surviving team into Shadesmar.

graphNodes.name: Moash kills Elhokar
graphNodes.summary: Elhokar protects Gavinor and begins speaking the first Lightweaver Ideal, but Moash kills him and gives Kaladin the Bridge Four salute.

graphNodes.name: Kholinar survivors are trapped in Shadesmar
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin, Shallan, Adolin, Azure, Syl, and Pattern must reach Thaylen City through the Cognitive Realm while carrying limited Stormlight and coping with deadeye Maya.

graphNodes.name: The group visits Riino’s lighthouse
graphNodes.summary: Riino recognizes Kaladin’s Investiture, offers a future-reading device, and points the travelers toward Celebrant.

graphNodes.name: Notum carries the group on Honor’s Path
graphNodes.summary: The travelers negotiate passage with honorspren, learn more about deadeyes and Syl’s political status, and struggle with limited resources.

graphNodes.name: The travelers reach Celebrant
graphNodes.summary: At the spren market city, the group seeks transport toward Thaylenah while Fused pursuit closes in.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar fully remembers Evi and the Rift
graphNodes.summary: Cultivation’s pruning ends. Dalinar relives the burning of Rathalas and Evi’s death while political pressure and alcohol threaten to collapse him.

graphNodes.name: Taravangian bargains with Odium and betrays the coalition
graphNodes.summary: With the Diagram’s predictions failing, Taravangian offers information and service in exchange for protection of Kharbranth and its people.

graphNodes.name: Odium attacks Thaylen City
graphNodes.summary: Fused strike the gemstone reserve and Oathgate while the Thrill corrupts Amaram’s Sadeas army. Coalition forces are scattered or trapped.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar refuses to give Odium his pain
graphNodes.summary: Odium frames the Blackthorn’s atrocities as something external he can remove. Dalinar accepts that the crimes are his, insists responsibility still permits change, and rejects becoming Odium’s champion.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar opens Honor’s Perpendicularity
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar unites the three Realms, flooding the battlefield with Stormlight and creating a path that returns the Shadesmar group.

graphNodes.name: Radiants and coalition counterattack at Thaylen Field
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin fights Amaram, Shallan fields an illusion army, Jasnah Soulcasts at scale, Renarin resists prediction, Lift supports Dalinar, Szeth chooses Dalinar, and Bridge Four joins the defense.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar captures Nergaoul in the King’s Drop
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar confronts the Thrill as a familiar influence and traps the Unmade in the perfect ruby.

graphNodes.name: Jasnah is selected as queen of Alethkar
graphNodes.summary: With Elhokar dead and Gavinor a child, Alethi leadership chooses Jasnah rather than simply transferring power to Dalinar or Adolin.

graphNodes.name: Shallan and Adolin marry
graphNodes.summary: Shallan chooses a life with Adolin while acknowledging Veil and Radiant remain parts of her rather than problems instantly solved by marriage.

graphNodes.name: Moash kills Jezrien and becomes Vyre
graphNodes.summary: Odium’s servants give Moash a specialized dagger. He kills the broken Herald Ahu/Jezrien and accepts a new name and role.

graphNodes.name: Wit rescues and bonds Elhokar’s Cryptic
graphNodes.summary: In occupied Kholinar, Wit retrieves a Cryptic that had been moving toward Elhokar and begins a Lightweaver bond while evading Fused patrols.

graphNodes.name: Ghost ship First Dreams returns from Aimia
graphNodes.summary: Yalb and another crew discover the First Dreams drifting back from the direction of Aimia with its expedition crew missing, triggering concern that Akinah may have become a strategic threat.

graphNodes.name: Rysn negotiates command of the Akinah expedition
graphNodes.summary: Chiri-Chiri’s illness points toward Akinah, while Navani needs the island investigated. Rysn negotiates pay, authority, Windrunner support, and scholarly participation before agreeing to sail.

graphNodes.name: Voyage research produces a mobility fabrial for Rysn
graphNodes.summary: Huio’s observations about aluminum and fabrial behavior give Rushu a practical route toward a fabrial-assisted mobility device adapted for Rysn aboard ship.

graphNodes.name: Wandersail penetrates Akinah’s storm barrier
graphNodes.summary: The expedition reaches the hidden city, discovers deliberate false structures around the Oathgate, and realizes Akinah is defended by deception as much as by weather.

graphNodes.name: Nikli reveals himself as a Sleepless guardian
graphNodes.summary: Nikli dissolves the human disguise into hordelings and moves to eliminate the expedition after the hidden caverns are breached.

graphNodes.name: The Dawnshard bonds Rysn
graphNodes.summary: A Command housed in the Akinah mural leaves its container and attaches to Rysn, making her the bearer of a Dawnshard.

graphNodes.name: Huio swears the Third Ideal
graphNodes.summary: While the Windrunners fight Sleepless hordelings, Huio’s need to protect Lopen pushes him to the Third Ideal and Caelinora manifests as a living Shardweapon.

graphNodes.name: Rysn negotiates a compact with the Sleepless
graphNodes.summary: Rysn bargains for the expedition’s survival and safe return. The Sleepless accept a layered cover story, continued guardianship of Rysn, and the removal of selected Akinah artifacts while the Dawnshard remains hidden on her person.

graphNodes.name: Lopen swears the Third Ideal
graphNodes.summary: Reflecting on how his humor can hurt people he means to help, Lopen finds the personal form of the Third Ideal; Rua can now become a living Shardweapon.

graphNodes.name: Navani’s view of Gavilar’s final night reframes his secret project
graphNodes.summary: Navani’s perspective reveals Gavilar’s secret meetings, his cruelty toward her scholarly identity, unusual Light-related spheres, and his deeper involvement with Heralds and offworld-scale ambitions.

graphNodes.name: Coalition rescues Hearthstone and captures Fused suppression technology
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin and the Windrunners evacuate Hearthstone while fighting Leshwi and Lezian. A suppression device that interferes with Radiant powers is captured for Navani’s study.

graphNodes.name: Ialai dies and Shallan inherits a Ghostblood/Restares trail
graphNodes.summary: During Shallan’s operation against Ialai Sadeas, Ialai is poisoned and leaves behind notes pointing toward Restares, Thaidakar, and wider Cosmere connections. Shallan initially assumes an infiltrator is responsible.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar relieves Kaladin from frontline command
graphNodes.summary: Recognizing that repeated combat trauma is impairing Kaladin’s ability to function, Dalinar removes him from active battlefield command despite Kaladin’s identity being built around protecting through fighting.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin builds a clinic and peer-support model
graphNodes.summary: Working again as a surgeon, Kaladin recognizes that many soldiers and civilians need community, routine, listening, and humane treatment rather than confinement. He begins structured group support, including Noril.

graphNodes.name: Adolin and Shallan depart for Lasting Integrity
graphNodes.summary: The coalition sends a mixed Radiant delegation through Shadesmar to persuade honorspren to renew bonds. Shallan simultaneously pursues Mraize’s order to identify Restares.

graphNodes.name: Raboniel convinces the Nine to attack Urithiru
graphNodes.summary: Raboniel argues that human Radiants and fabrial science are advancing faster than the Fused can tolerate and that the tower must be seized before its full ancient defenses are restored.

graphNodes.name: Raboniel captures Urithiru and inverts the tower defenses
graphNodes.summary: Fused infiltrators reach the crystal pillar, infuse it with Voidlight, and invert the Sibling’s protections. Most Radiants in the tower collapse unconscious while singer forces enter through the Oathgates and balconies.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin becomes the tower’s mobile resistance fighter
graphNodes.summary: Because Adhesion and his advanced bond are suppressed differently, Kaladin retains limited capability. Guided by the Sibling and aided by Dabbid and later fabrials, he sabotages corruption nodes, protects unconscious Radiants, and evades Lezian.

graphNodes.name: Navani and Raboniel become scientific collaborators under occupation
graphNodes.summary: Raboniel turns Navani’s captivity into a research partnership. Their experiments establish that Lights respond to tones and rhythms and that apparently opposed forms of Investiture can be manipulated with wave-like precision.

graphNodes.name: Navani and Raboniel create Warlight
graphNodes.summary: Navani matches Honor’s tone while Raboniel sings Odium’s; instead of destroying one another, Stormlight and Voidlight harmonize into a stable hybrid Light associated with the Rhythm of War.

graphNodes.name: Restares is revealed as the Herald Kalak
graphNodes.summary: The elusive Sons of Honor leader Restares is revealed to be Kalak, one of the Heralds and the High Judge of Lasting Integrity. He is desperate to escape Roshar and the cycle trapping the Heralds.

graphNodes.name: Adolin accepts trial by witness in Lasting Integrity
graphNodes.summary: The honorspren put the human-spren relationship itself on trial through Adolin. Witnesses, politics, Notum’s conscience, and Maya’s growing responsiveness turn the proceeding into a referendum on the meaning of the Recreance.

graphNodes.name: Maya testifies: the ancient spren chose the Recreance
graphNodes.summary: Drawing strength through her connection with Adolin, Maya speaks and rejects the claim that ancient Radiants alone betrayed helpless spren. The spren knowingly joined the decision to break the bonds, though neither side expected deadeyes to result.

graphNodes.name: Shallan learns Radiant killed Ialai and integrates Veil
graphNodes.summary: Shallan’s feared “Formless” is not a new external personality taking over. She confronts the truth that Radiant poisoned Ialai to protect her, and Veil’s role as a protective partition reaches an end as Shallan integrates those memories.

graphNodes.name: Navani produces anti-Voidlight
graphNodes.summary: Using destructive-interference reasoning, isolated transfer, and a precisely inverted tone, Navani creates a form of Light that reacts catastrophically with Voidlight.

graphNodes.name: Raboniel permanently releases her daughter with anti-Voidlight
graphNodes.summary: Raboniel weaponizes the new anti-Voidlight in a raysium dagger and uses it on her deeply damaged Fused daughter, ending the cycle of rebirth rather than sending her back to Braize.

graphNodes.name: Moash permanently kills Phendorana and murders Teft
graphNodes.summary: During the final collapse of the occupation, Moash uses an anti-Stormlight weapon to destroy Phendorana permanently, then kills Teft. Teft dies knowing he is loved and that his life had become worth fighting for.

graphNodes.name: Kaladin accepts the Fourth Ideal and manifests living Shardplate
graphNodes.summary: After a vision/connection with Tien helps him face the truth that some people cannot be saved, Kaladin stops treating every death as proof of personal failure. He swears the Fourth Ideal and windspren form living Shardplate around him.

graphNodes.name: Navani bonds the Sibling and restores Towerlight
graphNodes.summary: Navani rejects Gavilar’s old dismissal of her scholarship, matches Honor’s tone against the Sibling’s Cultivation tone, and forms a Bondsmith bond. Together they restore Towerlight and retake the tower systems.

graphNodes.name: Urithiru awakens and the occupation collapses
graphNodes.summary: The Sibling reactivates tower fabrials and defenses, waking Radiants and suppressing hostile forces. Kaladin’s public return and singer defections turn the occupation into a rout.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar confronts Ishar and discovers Physical spren experiments
graphNodes.summary: In Tukar, Ishar demonstrates terrifying unbound Bondsmith control over Connection, tries to take Dalinar’s bond, and retreats after Nightblood disrupts the attack. His camp contains dead spren given unnatural Physical bodies.

graphNodes.name: Rlain bonds Tumi and becomes a Truthwatcher
graphNodes.summary: Tumi, an enlightened mistspren from Sja-anat’s network, chooses Rlain. The bond gives Rlain a Radiant path that is neither a token human appointment nor a surrender of listener identity.

graphNodes.name: Dalinar and Odium agree to a contest of champions in ten days
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar and Rayse formalize terms: either outcome stops the immediate war and keeps Odium bound to the system, while territorial control and Dalinar’s future service as a Fused depend on the champion result.

graphNodes.name: Venli and sympathetic Fused leave to seek the surviving listeners
graphNodes.summary: After learning that listeners survived on the Shattered Plains and openly using her Radiant bond, Venli chooses a future outside Odium’s hierarchy. Leshwi and several Fused join the break.

graphNodes.name: Taravangian kills Rayse with Nightblood and becomes Odium
graphNodes.summary: Taravangian’s most emotional and least intelligent day aligns him with Odium’s Intent. As Szeth attacks his mortal body and Rayse pulls his mind into a vision, Taravangian uses Nightblood to kill Rayse, then takes up the Shard.

graphNodes.name: Shallan acknowledges Testament as her first Cryptic
graphNodes.summary: Shallan finally admits that she had bonded a Cryptic before Pattern, broke those oaths after killing her mother, and left Testament a deadeye. She tells Adolin rather than hiding the truth behind another persona.

graphNodes.name: El permanently kills Lezian using anti-Stormlight research
graphNodes.summary: After Lezian returns furious from defeat, El uses the newly shared anti-Light discoveries to kill him permanently, demonstrating that the technology is already propagating beyond Navani and Raboniel.

graphNodes.name: Stormfather gives Eshonai one final journey across Roshar
graphNodes.summary: The book returns to Eshonai’s actual death after Narak. The Stormfather accepts her final struggle as enough for the First Ideal to briefly sustain her Cognitive self, then carries her across Roshar so the explorer can finally see the world before passing Beyond.

graphNodes.name: The new Odium alters Wit’s Breath-stored memories and replays their meeting
graphNodes.summary: Wit notices that Odium does not behave like Rayse and nearly identifies the Vessel change. Taravangian-Odium removes some memories stored in Wit’s Breaths, resets the encounter, and performs Rayse’s expected manner more convincingly.

graphNodes.name: The Way of Kings
graphNodes.summary: Kaladin is reduced from soldier to slave and then rebuilds Bridge Four; Dalinar follows visions while Alethi politics fracture; Shallan seeks Jasnah as both ward and would-be thief; Szeth’s assassination campaign expands.

graphNodes.name: Words of Radiance
graphNodes.summary: The viewpoint lines converge on the Shattered Plains; Shallan develops as a Lightweaver and enters Ghostblood politics; Kaladin’s oaths are tested; the listeners summon the Everstorm; Urithiru is rediscovered.

graphNodes.name: Edgedancer
graphNodes.summary: Lift leaves Azimir for Yeddaw, follows Nale’s pursuit of budding Radiants, encounters the Stump and the Sleepless, and reaches a new understanding of what it means to remember people others overlook.

graphNodes.name: Oathbringer
graphNodes.summary: Dalinar builds a coalition while recovering the truth of his past; Urithiru, Kholinar, Shadesmar, and Thaylen Field become linked fronts; old identities and loyalties fracture; the Desolation becomes an open world war.

graphNodes.name: Dawnshard
graphNodes.summary: Rysn leads the Wandersail expedition to Akinah while Lopen and Huio accompany the mission as Windrunners. The expedition discovers the Sleepless defenses, ancient caches, and a Dawnshard whose Command bonds to Rysn.

graphNodes.name: Rhythm of War
graphNodes.summary: The war shifts toward technology, spren politics, and control of Urithiru. Navani and Raboniel transform the science of Light; Kaladin resists the occupation of the tower; Adolin and Shallan enter Lasting Integrity; Venli confronts responsibility for her people; the conflict with Odium changes at its source.

graphNodes.name: Elantris
graphNodes.summary: Introduces Sel and one traveler later seen on Roshar. The Roshar cameo is intentionally subtle.

graphNodes.name: Mistborn: The Final Empire
graphNodes.summary: Introduces Scadrial and metal-based Investiture; one later Roshar visitor originated here.

graphNodes.name: The Well of Ascension
graphNodes.summary: Part of the Scadrian background relevant to broader Cosmere mechanics, not required for Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: The Hero of Ages
graphNodes.summary: Completes Era 1 and makes Shards and planetary Investiture easier to recognize.

graphNodes.name: Warbreaker
graphNodes.summary: The most useful non-Stormlight companion before Oathbringer: explains the origins of Zahel, Azure, Nightblood, Breath, and Awakening.

graphNodes.name: The Alloy of Law
graphNodes.summary: Later Scadrial; useful only for broad Cosmere context at this spoiler boundary.

graphNodes.name: The Emperor’s Soul
graphNodes.summary: Compact explanation of Identity, Connection, and a different expression of Investiture.

graphNodes.name: The Eleventh Metal
graphNodes.summary: Prequel story; no direct Oathbringer requirement.

graphNodes.name: The Hope of Elantris
graphNodes.summary: Side story on Sel; no direct Oathbringer requirement.

graphNodes.name: Shadows for Silence in the Forests of Hell
graphNodes.summary: Shows another world’s Cognitive Shadows and Investiture rules.

graphNodes.name: Allomancer Jak and the Pits of Eltania
graphNodes.summary: Scadrian side story; no direct Stormlight dependency.

graphNodes.name: Sixth of the Dusk
graphNodes.summary: Shows a distant Cosmere culture and invested ecology; not needed for Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Shadows of Self
graphNodes.summary: Broader Shard and magic context; not directly tied to Oathbringer’s plot.

graphNodes.name: The Bands of Mourning
graphNodes.summary: Expands Scadrian Identity and Connection mechanics, useful for theory but not required.

graphNodes.name: Mistborn: Secret History
graphNodes.summary: Makes the Cognitive Realm and Shardic conflict more explicit. Contains major Mistborn spoilers.

graphNodes.name: White Sand, Volume 1
graphNodes.summary: Introduces Taldain; white sand later acts as a practical Investiture indicator in Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: Arcanum Unbounded
graphNodes.summary: Contains Edgedancer, planetary-system essays, and several earlier short works. The essays supply cross-Cosmere framing available before Oathbringer.

graphNodes.name: White Sand, Volume 2
graphNodes.summary: Continues Taldain background. White sand remains a useful Investiture detector in Rhythm of War-era research.

graphNodes.name: White Sand, Volume 3
graphNodes.summary: Completes the original graphic-novel run available before Rhythm of War; relevant mainly to Taldain and white-sand Investiture detection.

graphNodes.name: Dawnshard
graphNodes.summary: Stormlight 3.5. Read between Oathbringer and Rhythm of War; introduces the Dawnshard revelation on Akinah and materially updates Rysn, Lopen, Huio, Cord, and the Sleepless.

graphNodes.name: Rhythm of War
graphNodes.summary: Stormlight book 4 and this atlas’s spoiler ceiling.

graphEdges.label: brothers
graphEdges.summary: Dalinar is Gavilar’s younger brother and principal military partner during unification.

graphEdges.label: married to
graphEdges.summary: Political marriage becomes emotionally important despite Dalinar’s neglect; ends with Evi’s death at the Rift.

graphEdges.label: married to
graphEdges.summary: Long-suppressed affection becomes an open partnership and formal marriage in Oathbringer.

graphEdges.label: married to
graphEdges.summary: Royal marriage before Gavilar’s assassination; politically powerful but emotionally difficult.

graphEdges.label: betrothed, then married
graphEdges.summary: Political betrothal grows into a genuine relationship; married after Thaylen Field.

graphEdges.label: brothers
graphEdges.summary: Tien’s death is the defining wound behind Kaladin’s compulsion to save everyone.

graphEdges.label: sisters
graphEdges.summary: Love, rivalry, and Venli’s manipulation shape the listener tragedy.

graphEdges.label: bonded to
graphEdges.summary: Windrunner–honorspren bond structured by protection oaths.

graphEdges.label: bonded to
graphEdges.summary: Lightweaver–Cryptic bond structured by acknowledged truths.

graphEdges.label: bonded to
graphEdges.summary: Bondsmith bond accepted at the end of WoR.

graphEdges.label: bonded to
graphEdges.summary: Truthwatcher bond altered by Sja-anat’s enlightenment of Glys.

graphEdges.label: bonded to
graphEdges.summary: Secret Willshaper bond begins while Venli still serves Odium.

graphEdges.label: enlightened
graphEdges.summary: Sja-anat changed Glys before or during the bond with Renarin.

graphEdges.label: suppresses
graphEdges.summary: Timbre traps the voidspren in Venli’s gemheart, reducing his direct control.

graphEdges.label: mentor of
graphEdges.summary: Scholarship, philosophy, politics, and Surgebinding; complicated by Shallan’s original theft.

graphEdges.label: early supporter of
graphEdges.summary: Teft recognizes Radiant signs and helps Kaladin understand the oaths.

graphEdges.label: former master of
graphEdges.summary: Sigzil was trained as a Worldsinger apprentice before Bridge Four.

graphEdges.label: trains
graphEdges.summary: Zahel assesses Kaladin and helps train the royal guard context.

graphEdges.label: babsk of
graphEdges.summary: Merchant master and apprentice relationship.

graphEdges.label: skeptical of
graphEdges.summary: Distrusts Lift’s chaos while recognizing her importance to Gawx.

graphEdges.label: trains
graphEdges.summary: Restores Szeth, gives him Nightblood, and inducts him into Skybreaker Ideals.

graphEdges.label: recruits and directs
graphEdges.summary: Ghostblood relationship based on tests, leverage, and selective information.

graphEdges.label: babsk of
graphEdges.summary: Iyatil is Mraize’s senior trainer within the Ghostbloods.

graphEdges.label: trains then attacks
graphEdges.summary: Tyn teaches con artistry before revealing her Ghostblood orders.

graphEdges.label: betrayed and enslaved
graphEdges.summary: Amaram steals the Shards Kaladin won and murders the surviving squad.

graphEdges.label: kills
graphEdges.summary: Rock fires the Shardbow shot that kills Amaram at Thaylen Field.

graphEdges.label: political ally turned enemy
graphEdges.summary: Abandons Dalinar at the Tower and promises ongoing sabotage.

graphEdges.label: kills
graphEdges.summary: Adolin kills Sadeas in Urithiru after a final threat.

graphEdges.label: kills
graphEdges.summary: Revenge for his grandparents culminates in Elhokar’s death.

graphEdges.label: kills
graphEdges.summary: Uses Odium’s gemstone dagger to kill the Herald.

graphEdges.label: former friend and ideological foil
graphEdges.summary: Bridge Four friendship breaks over the assassination plot and Moash’s choices.

graphEdges.label: secret master of
graphEdges.summary: Uses Szeth to assassinate rulers according to the Diagram.

graphEdges.label: tries to make champion
graphEdges.summary: Offers relief from guilt in exchange for surrendering responsibility.

graphEdges.label: cultivates ambition and forms
graphEdges.summary: Long-term manipulation leads to stormform and the Everstorm.

graphEdges.label: maneuvers into stormform
graphEdges.summary: Venli withholds risks and pressures Eshonai into testing stormform.

graphEdges.label: captures
graphEdges.summary: Recognizes the Thrill and traps it in the King’s Drop.

graphEdges.label: attempts to bond
graphEdges.summary: The Unmade consumes her when she cannot contain it.

graphEdges.label: bonds
graphEdges.summary: Amaram swallows the gem and gains multiple powers at the cost of transformation.

graphEdges.label: is Vasher
graphEdges.summary: Cross-book identity from Warbreaker to Stormlight.

graphEdges.label: is Vivenna
graphEdges.summary: Cross-book identity from Warbreaker to Oathbringer.

graphEdges.label: co-created
graphEdges.summary: Vasher helped create Nightblood on Nalthis.

graphEdges.label: searches for
graphEdges.summary: Azure’s offworld mission includes recovering or locating Nightblood.

graphEdges.label: searches for
graphEdges.summary: Azure also seeks Zahel/Vasher in Roshar and Shadesmar.

graphEdges.label: rivals to trusted allies
